description:
The Art Operation: how to build and run a mature artistic practice.

Nine chapters and three appendices: the Witness-Box doctrine and opening the shop, the six preparations, the human algorithm of process, diligence as civic virtue and the public audit trail, implementation and the Master Plan, operational continuity and the savepoint, rehearsal and experiment, the workspace as instrument, and how to be a good Operator — plus the formal workspace theory, the Historiotheque as worked example, and a glossary.
title: Art-Ops-In-A-Box Manual
